title: Muthoot Finance Q2 cons profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 3,278 crore
summary: Muthoot Finance reported a 36% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 3,278 crore in Q2, while assets under management grew 42% to Rs 2.09 lakh crore. However, standalone gross NPA ratio rose to 3.87% from 2.28% in the previous quarter, indicating a deterioration in asset quality

title: CBDT tightens merger rules for charity trusts, imposes five-year curbs on changing objectives
summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has made it mandatory for organisations merging with another registered non-profit to inform the I-T Department within a prescribed deadline, get their accounts audited and disclose the reasons for the merger. title: Sebi to release FII compliance consultation paper within weeks, says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey

The regulator is also planning a capacity-building network to strengthen independent directors’ effectiveness.
